title: Hot Take: Historic usage rates are fueling Luka Doncic and the Lakers' offense
author: Rico
summary: ESPN's "Historic usage rates are fueling Luka Doncic and the Lakers' offense" is the headline, and if that doesn't set off alarm bells, you haven't been paying attention to how these narratives age.

content.value:
## The Headline

ESPN — Ben Golliver: **"Historic usage rates are fueling Luka Doncic and the Lakers' offense"**

That's the kind of line that reads one way in October and a completely different way come April. Here's the read right now, before anyone's kept score. "Historic usage rates" and "fueling" in the same sentence should make you nervous, not excited — we've seen this movie before, and the third act usually involves a flameout in the second round when the defense tightens and there's no Plan B. But sure, let's celebrate the box score dominance while we can.
